skill.displayName: Event Rental Company Video — AI Promo Videos for Party Rental and Event Equipment Businesses
skill.summary: Event rental companies — tents, tables, chairs, linens, lighting, dance floors, photo booths — lose bookings every day to competitors who look bigger online....

latestVersion.changelog:
Event Rental Company Video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches skill for creating promo and catalog videos specifically for event rental and party equipment businesses.
- Supports video types including inventory showcases, package explainers, venue partner introductions, seasonal promos, and Google Business/SEO content.
- Accepts user assets (photos, brand materials) and customizes video style, format, and CTAs.
- Outputs ready-to-use videos for multiple online channels, streamlining marketing and booking processes for party rental companies.
